description: Generate a textured 3D model as a GLB file, from a text prompt or from one of the user's images (image_id: the app's Convert to 3D, the image and the model linked), saved as a new model asset in the user's Voidless library. For a model the user already has use upload_3d_model; for a 2D sprite use generate_image. 45 credits for mode 'game' or 15 for an 'lq' draft, charged on every call and refunded if it fails; a slow run returns a job for check_generation. Returns the asset ID, the GLB link, a thumbnail and the seed; a character goes on to rig_3d_model, then animate_3d_model. For a free voxel model made at once (Voidless Monarch 3D), use generate_image with model 'free' and free.mode '3d'; to carve a picture of four views (top, side, front, back) into a sprite stack and voxel GLB for free, make_sprite_stack.

bodyType.description: type 'character' only: the body plan (default humanoid; with image_id, the image's own). Ignored for objects

image_id.description: Build the model from one of your image assets instead of drawing a reference (its picture is cut out and used as it is). The model is linked to the image, so sprites rendered from it go back onto that image

mode.description: game = game-ready, a light clean mesh of about 19k triangles (45 credits); lq = draft (15 credits). hq is an old name for game

palette.description: Colour scheme of the model's texture, as the app's 3D generator offers (default none: the prompt's own colours). Named palettes (fixed colours, the same as Voidless Monarch's): pico8, gameboy, nes, endesga32, endesga64, sweetie16, resurrect64, aap64, apollo, pear36, lospec500, steamlords, oil6, twilight5, islandjoy16, fantasy24, zughy32, cga, c64, zxspectrum, 1bit (common spellings like 'pico-8', 'game boy', '1-bit' work too). Moods (no fixed colours): black-and-white, retro, vibrant, pastel, neon, earthy, sepia, sunset, ice, dungeon, forest, desert, candy, cyberpunk.

prompt.description: The single model to make, with its shape, materials and colours, e.g. 'wooden treasure chest with iron bands'. Required without image_id; with one it is optional (default: the image's own prompt)

seed.description: RNG seed (0 = random, the default). The result reports the seed used

source_file.description: With image_id: which picture of it, an image key of that asset as get_asset lists it (an edit, or one view of a rotation set). Default: the image itself

style.description: 'low-poly' (default: faceted triangles, flat colours), 'blocky' (voxel art, built from cubes), 'claymation', 'origami', 'hand-painted' (stylized fantasy) or 'toy' (glossy vinyl figure)

type.description: 'character' makes a T-posed figure ready for rigging (default 'object'; with image_id, from the image's own type)

name: generate_3d_model
